name: FV_DATA_ACT_BALANCES_EXTRACT
description: This table stores the calculated balance amount for the DATA Act Files.

columns.name: BALANCES_EXTRACT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the report balance

columns.name: FILE_CODE
columns.description: File code that has been processed.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Sequence number to identify the report balance for a file code

columns.name: TREASURY_ACCOUNT_SYMBOL
columns.description: The identification code assigned by Treasury, in collaboration with Office of Management and Budget and the owner agency, to an individual appropriation, receipt, or other fund account.

columns.name: PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_CODE
columns.description: The program activity code for the agency defined in federal attribute supplemental rules.

columns.name: PARK_CODE
columns.description: The Program Activity Reporting Key for the agency defined in federal attribute supplemental rules.

columns.name: PYA_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the prior year adjustment codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_PRIOR_YEAR_ADJUSTMENT lookup.

columns.name: BUDGET_OBJECT_CLASS
columns.description: The budget object class code defined in federal attribute supplemental rules.

columns.name: DIRECT_OR_REIMBURSABLE_CODE
columns.description: The direct or reimbursable code defined in federal fund attributes. It is based on the ORA_FV_DIRECT_OR_REIMBURSEABLE lookup. Valid values are D and R.

columns.name: DISASTER_EMERGENCY_FUND_CODE
columns.description: The disaster emergency fund code defined in federal attribute supplemental rules.

columns.name: PIID_NUMBER
columns.description: The procurement instrument identifier derived from the purchase order.

columns.name: PARENT_AWARD_NUMBER
columns.description: The parent award number derived from the purchase order.

columns.name: FAIN_NUMBER
columns.description: The federal award identification number derived from the purchase order.

columns.name: URI
columns.description: The uniform resource identifier derived from the purchase order.

columns.name: TO_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Period number that idecates till which period the report has been executed.

columns.name: REPORT_RUN_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the file processing attributes.
